== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Rebel Leadership (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata)]] (<code>1230_109</code>, Virtual Block 3 slip 110), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text: the Virtual Block 3 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB3-110-Rebel_Leadership.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB3-L-rebelleadership-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Rebel Leadership (V) (Virtual Block 3)]]. The Master List prints this text on its slip only (no full card).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), official text as of 27 April 2013, p. 35 ([[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf]]; preserved copy of the original: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]). Icons and the errata mark E as on that slip.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “▲ an admiral or a non-Jedi general. OR Once per game, ▼ a war room. OR If your admiral or non-[Episode I] general is in battle, may add one battle destiny or prevent opponent from drawing more than one battle destiny (their battle destiny draws may not be canceled).”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1230_109</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 3 set mark, slip number as on the Players Committee card image, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Errata mark E in place of the slip number, as on the Master List slip; concept credit as printed. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB3-110-Rebel_Leadership-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B06 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
